entities.summary: Japanese, a notable figure in the history of Philippines, associated with World War II and Japanese Occupation (1941–1944). Preceded by Philippines achieves full independence from the United States. Their legacy influenced Bataan Death March — thousands of Filipino and American POWs die and MacArthur's famous pledge: 'I shall return'.
